svg.aria-label: Map of St Thérèse's places and churches, numbered: 1 Alençon, with her birthplace on rue Saint-Blaise and Notre-Dame d'Alençon, where she was baptised; 2 Lisieux, with Les Buissonnets, the Cathedral of St Pierre, the Carmel where she lived and died, and the Basilica of St Thérèse; 3 Paris, where she prayed at Our Lady of Victories; 4 Rome, where she asked Pope Leo XIII on 20 November 1887 to let her enter Carmel at fifteen. A dashed line traces her pilgrimage of November and December 1887 from Lisieux through Paris and Switzerland to Milan, Venice, Padua, Bologna, Loreto, Rome, Naples and Pompeii, and home by Assisi, Florence, Pisa, Genoa and the Riviera. Insets show Lisieux and Alençon in close-up.

g.text: Shrines she visited on the way
